_status: ILLUSTRATIVE generic FAO values, not locally calibrated. Added for user-built rotations (D15). Values transcribed from the FAO-56 online tables; midpoints are used where a table prints a range.

profile.name: Spring wheat

kc_ini.reference: FAO-56 (Allen et al. 1998) Table 12, Cereals group Kc ini 0.3 (row blank)
kc_ini.region_relevance: Generic; Table 12 footnote 1: depends on wetting interval (FAO-56 Fig. 29/30, Annex 7)

kc_mid.reference: FAO-56 (Allen et al. 1998) Table 12, Spring Wheat Kc mid 1.15
kc_mid.region_relevance: Sub-humid reference climate (RHmin 45%, u2 2 m/s); adjusted with FAO-56 eq. 62 at run time

kc_end.reference: FAO-56 (Allen et al. 1998) Table 12, Spring Wheat Kc end 0.25-0.4 (midpoint used; footnote 10: the higher value for hand-harvested crops)
kc_end.region_relevance: Sub-humid reference climate; adjusted with FAO-56 eq. 65 when Kc end > 0.45

ini.reference: FAO-56 (Allen et al. 1998) Table 11, cereals row 'Barley/Oats/Wheat', March/April planting, 35-45 deg latitude (20/25/60/30, total 135) (ini)
ini.region_relevance: Table 11 has no row labelled 'Spring wheat'; this unlabelled small-grain row is the closest and is disclosed as an assumption
ini.uncertainty: Table 11 footnote: indicative only; varies with region, climate and variety

dev.reference: FAO-56 (Allen et al. 1998) Table 11, cereals row 'Barley/Oats/Wheat', March/April planting, 35-45 deg latitude (20/25/60/30, total 135) (dev)
dev.region_relevance: Table 11 has no row labelled 'Spring wheat'; this unlabelled small-grain row is the closest and is disclosed as an assumption
dev.uncertainty: Table 11 footnote: indicative only; varies with region, climate and variety

mid.reference: FAO-56 (Allen et al. 1998) Table 11, cereals row 'Barley/Oats/Wheat', March/April planting, 35-45 deg latitude (20/25/60/30, total 135) (mid)
mid.region_relevance: Table 11 has no row labelled 'Spring wheat'; this unlabelled small-grain row is the closest and is disclosed as an assumption
mid.uncertainty: Table 11 footnote: indicative only; varies with region, climate and variety

late.reference: FAO-56 (Allen et al. 1998) Table 11, cereals row 'Barley/Oats/Wheat', March/April planting, 35-45 deg latitude (20/25/60/30, total 135) (late)
late.region_relevance: Table 11 has no row labelled 'Spring wheat'; this unlabelled small-grain row is the closest and is disclosed as an assumption
late.uncertainty: Table 11 footnote: indicative only; varies with region, climate and variety

max_root_depth_m.reference: FAO-56 (Allen et al. 1998) Table 22, Spring Wheat: Zr 1.0-1.5 m
max_root_depth_m.region_relevance: Larger value for modelling soil water stress (Table 22 footnote 1)

depletion_fraction_p.reference: FAO-56 (Allen et al. 1998) Table 22, Spring Wheat: p 0.55
depletion_fraction_p.region_relevance: Generic; p = p_table + 0.04(5 - ETc) at run time (Table 22 footnote 2)

ky_season.reference: FAO-56 Chapter 8 Table 24 'Seasonal yield response functions from FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper No. 33' (Doorenbos & Kassam 1979), value 1.15
ky_season.region_relevance: Generic; applied to the whole growing period, water-limited yield only
ky_season.uncertainty: Seasonal Ky only (stage-specific values are not in Table 24); varies with variety and climate

profile.notes: Stage lengths come from the generic small-grain row, not a row labelled spring wheat.

max_height_m.reference: FAO-56 (Allen et al. 1998) Table 12, Spring Wheat h 1 m
